content.text:
The robot found the red ball and stopped about 0.3 m from it, facing it. I then called rest, and the robot is now crouched with its motors off.

The ball was off to the left of the robot's starting heading, near the far wall beyond a cabinet. The last camera check, before rest, showed the ball centred just in front of the feet. The camera view after rest no longer shows the ball.
